$schema_description: Structure that every rule object in legal_metrology_rules.json and fssai_rules.json must follow.
description: string — plain-language summary of what this rule requires

applicability.commodity_category: string or array — e.g. all, food_items, namkeen, cosmetics
applicability.exemption_conditions: string — conditions under which this rule does NOT apply, or NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE

expected_value_or_format: string — exact requirement text used by the rule engine to check extracted data

legal_reference.source_document: string — name of the source regulation
legal_reference.schedule_reference: string or NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE — Schedule number if applicable

effective_to: date, null (still in force), or NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE
